settingsSub: Set your appearance preferences, MCP access and model services.
appearanceWhy: Choose your theme and interface language.
browserOnly: Only in this browser; changes do not sync across devices.
storageWhy: Two sources of knowledge, each with a clear role.
structuredWhy: Context items such as facts, preferences and decisions are stored in PostgreSQL.
documentsWhy: Markdown files hold document content. Database records support metadata and indexing.
retrievalWhy: Review retrieval configuration and derived index coverage for this Depot.
connectionsWhy: Connect compatible agents and tools to your knowledge.
helpWhy: Use the endpoint and access key supplied by your deployment administrator. Access keys are never shown or stored in this browser.
aboutWhy: A personal knowledge system for useful context, organized over time.
InvalidAppearanceTheme: Theme must be system, light or dark.
InvalidAppearanceLanguage: Language must be zh-CN or en-US.
themeChangeError: Could not switch theme. Your previous theme has been kept.
languageChangeError: Could not switch language. Your previous language has been kept.
appearanceLoadError: Appearance settings could not be loaded. Please reconnect.
SettingsForbidden: Settings management requires trusted Web access.
InvalidInferenceConfiguration: Invalid Model services configuration. Check the endpoint, model, dimensions and API key.
settingsKeysWhy: Give each client its own key and explicit Workspace access.
settingsNoWorkspaces: Create a Workspace before issuing an access key.
settingsNoKeysWhy: Create a key to connect your first MCP client.
settingsKeyOnce: This is the only time the full key is shown. Store it securely before closing.
settingsRotateWhy: A new key keeps the same Workspace access. The old key stops working immediately.
settingsRevokeWhy: This key will immediately stop accepting new MCP requests. This cannot be undone.
settingsGrantsWhy: Choose the Workspaces this client can read and write through MCP.
settingsGrantsExact: Access applies only to selected Workspaces. Child Workspaces must be selected separately.
settingsKeySaveError: The access key operation failed. Your draft is preserved; retry after checking the connection.
settingsConflict: This configuration has changed. Your draft is preserved. Load the latest configuration to discard this draft, review the changes and edit again.
settingsKeyInactive: This key has been revoked or removed. Close this dialog and choose an active key.
settingsProviderRemoved: This provider has been removed. Close this dialog and choose another provider.
settingsForbidden: This connection cannot manage settings. Use the trusted Web deployment.
settingsInferenceWhy: Choose the model services you want to use. Search and chat can be set up separately.
settingsEmbeddingWhy: Find related knowledge even when your question uses different words.
settingsChatWhy: Chat is not available in this app yet. You can leave this for later.
settingsDimensionsHint: The number of values in each text embedding. Enter an output dimension supported by your model.
settingsDimensionsOtherModels: These are OpenAI model defaults. For other models, check the provider documentation.
settingsDimensionsChangeHint: Models that support custom dimensions can use a smaller value to reduce storage and computation, with a possible loss of retrieval accuracy. Changing dimensions rebuilds existing semantic indexes in the background.
settingsInferenceUnconfigured: Choose a provider and model to get started.
settingsInferencePending: Saved; runtime activation is pending. The last valid profile stays active.
settingsInferenceDialogWhy: Use an OpenAI-compatible API endpoint. Existing API keys are never returned to the browser.
settingsApiKeyKeep: Leave blank to keep the saved key. Enter a new key to replace it.
settingsApiKeyRequired: An API key is required for a new configuration.
settingsProfileChange: Changing the search model or dimensions updates search data in the background. Your saved knowledge stays the same.
settingsInferenceSavedPending: Model services configuration saved; runtime activation is pending.
settingsInferenceInvalid: Check all fields and provide an API key if no usable key is stored.
settingsInferenceSaveError: The provider could not be saved. Your draft is preserved; check the connection and retry.
settingsInvalid_providerName: Enter a provider name of 1–200 characters.
settingsInvalid_endpoint: Enter an HTTP(S) base URL without credentials, query parameters or a fragment. Azure requires /openai/v1/.
settingsInvalid_model: Enter a model name of 1–300 characters.
settingsInvalid_timeoutSeconds: Enter an integer between 1 and 300 seconds.
settingsInvalid_apiKey: Provide an API key of at most 8,192 characters.
settingsCopyError: Copy failed. Select and copy the value manually.
settingsKeywordWhy: Search your structured knowledge and indexed documents.
settingsSemanticWhy: Uses the embedding route. Configuration does not verify provider availability.
settingsEmbeddingLinkWhy: Manage the active provider, model and dimensions below.
settingsIndexWhy: Derived indexes can be rebuilt without changing original knowledge.
settingsConnectionReplace: Replace <access-key> with the key you saved.
settingsConnectStep1: Create an access key and select Workspace access above.
settingsConnectStep2: Add this MCP URL and X-ContextDepot-Key header to your client.
settingsConnectStep3: Use an address reachable by the client. Never share your access key.
settingsNoProvidersWhy: Add an OpenAI compatible endpoint and choose the models you need.
settingsModelsMissing: Choose Configure on a preset to add credentials and assign a model.
settingsProviderDialogWhy: Choose a model service, enter the address and key it provides, then choose your models.
settingsProviderSwitch: Saving will replace the current provider: {{name}}.
settingsProviderDisable: Saving will unassign this capability. Keyword search remains available.
settingsProviderModelsHint: Turn on the features you need. You can set up the others later.
settingsProviderEndpointHint: Enter the API base URL, without a model or request path.
settingsProviderAzureEndpoint: Use your resource URL ending in /openai/v1/. Enter the deployment name in each model field.
settingsProviderEmbeddingUnsupported: This preset supports Chat. Choose another provider for embeddings.
settingsRouteDialogWhy: This choice applies only to this capability. Embedding and Chat can use different providers.
settingsRouteProviderHint: Choose a connected provider or connect another one.
settingsRouteDisable: Saving will unassign this capability. The other capability will keep its current provider.
settingsRouteSaveError: The model configuration could not be saved. Your draft is preserved; retry after checking the connection.
settingsNoConnectionsWhy: Choose a feature above, then connect a model service. You only need to add the services you plan to use.
settingsEmbeddingEmpty: Connect a search model to find more related results.
settingsChatEmpty: Leave this blank if you do not need it yet.
settingsConnectModelWhy: Choose a model service, then enter its address, key and model name.
setupIntro: Give your knowledge a home, then choose how to search it and connect your apps.
setupResume: Everything is saved at the last step. Until then, keep this page open without refreshing so you do not lose what you have entered.
setupStepDetail_workspace: Keep related notes and resources together
setupStepDetail_inference: Search by meaning, now or later
setupStepDetail_accessKey: Use your knowledge in other apps
setupStepDetail_review: Check your choices and get started
setupWorkspaceWhy: Keep notes and resources on the same topic together, such as a work project, study notes or a personal collection. Start with one space and add more later.
setupInferenceTitle: Help search understand what you mean
setupInferenceWhy: A search model can find related content even when your question uses different words. You can also skip this and use keyword search.
setupInferenceNote: These details are saved at the last step. To search by meaning, make sure the model service can be reached.
setupMcpTitle: Use your knowledge in other apps
setupMcpWhy: Apps that support MCP can use a connection key to read and save knowledge in this space. Skip this if you do not need to connect an app yet.
setupMcpExampleWhy: Copy these settings into an app that supports MCP, then replace <YOUR_ACCESS_KEY> with the connection key generated later. The app must support HTTP connections.
setupKeyCreated: Your connection key is ready. Save it first.
setupCopyManualHint: If the copy button does not work, click a text box to select everything, then press Ctrl+C (⌘C on Mac).
setupKeyLeaveBlocked: The full key is shown only once. Copy it somewhere safe, then use the button below to continue.
setupReviewWhy: Check that these choices work for you. Once you confirm, you can start saving knowledge and add any skipped features in Settings later.
setupCheckWhy: Try again in a moment. Any settings already saved will be kept.
setupConflict: The settings have changed. Refresh the page and enter your choices again.
setupIncomplete: Finish the earlier steps first. Leave optional features blank and select Next to continue.
setupUnavailable: Setup is temporarily unavailable. Please try again in a moment.
setupInvalidWorkspace: Check the space name, English identifier and description, then try again.
setupInvalidStep: Finish the earlier steps before continuing.
setupDescriptionInvalid: The description is a little long. Please shorten it to 2,000 characters or fewer.
setupSpaceNamePlaceholder: e.g. Research notes, Work projects, Reading list
setupSpaceNameHint: Give your space a name you’ll recognize, like Research Notes or Work Projects.
setupSpacePathHint: We’ll fill this in from your space name, like research-notes for Research Notes. You can change it before saving.
setupSpacePathInvalid: Use lowercase letters and numbers, with single hyphens (-) between words. Keep it to 100 characters or fewer.
setupSpaceDescriptionPlaceholder: e.g. Reading highlights, research material and personal ideas
setupKeyOnce: The full key is shown only once. Copy it somewhere safe so you can use it to connect an app later.
setupWorkspaceNext: Next, you can set up search or leave it for later.
setupDraftUpdated: Your choice is noted. It will be saved with everything at the last step.
setupKeyOnFinish: Create a connection key for this space
setupKeyDraftWhy: If selected, the connection key appears after you save at the last step. Give it a name so you can recognize it later.
setupAtomicWhy: Everything is saved together. If saving does not succeed, what you entered stays on this page.
setupSavedWhy: Your settings are saved. You can start collecting and organizing knowledge.
setupCompletionUncertain: We have not confirmed whether your settings were saved
setupCompletionCheckWhy: No save result was received. Use the button below to check whether your settings were saved before trying again.
setupCompletionKeyLost: Your settings were saved, but the connection key did not appear. Go to Settings to generate a new key.
setupDraftLeaveTitle: Your choices have not been saved yet
setupDraftLeaveWhy: Continue to the last step and save before leaving.
